summary: Resolved blocking F7 on rulings.md: §5's option (a) now says a file naming a missing template fails its build (the failure §12 holds against its (b)), that this slice runs one such file, PipelinesDeploy's Jenkinsfile.architecture needing aac_tools with a first build that must be green, and splits (a) into (a1) this slice adds aac_tools to podYaml after all / (a2) that file uses an images: entry; the response slot takes a1 | a2 | b. Witnessed first: a scratch copy of PodYamlTest with a templates: ['aac_tools'] refusal case ran 27 green. The P4 done-record gives P8 the dependency.
